steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: And you... could you be my auspicious star?
A cold touch yanks you sharply back to the present. Lichen's fingertips are slowly tracing the shell of your ear. A burning ache prickles across every place her fingers graze.
Her two fingers abruptly clench, seizing your face in a firm grip.

You slam her hand aside, your little finger knocking against her wrist. As if she foresaw the blow, she loosens her hold without resistance. The recoil sends you spilling over the coffin's edge, your skull buzzing with a dull ring.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: It would be a shame to crack that head of yours. I still have many questions I'd like you to answer, young friend.
The cold hands return to your head, fingers sliding deep into your hair. A firm, steady pressure compels your face upward until you have no choice but to look at her.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Ah, but I suppose I should not be calling <color=#fb9259>you</color> that anymore. Should I?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't know what you're talking about...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: You don't? You pored over every word on that terminal yourself, did you not?

<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> This <color=#fb9259>auspicious star</color> you spoke of... his power runs deep, deeper than mortal hands should hold.
<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> He has worn a mask since the moment we met, has he not?
steps.female_content:
<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> This <color=#fb9259>auspicious star</color> you spoke of... her power runs deep, deeper than mortal hands should hold.
<color=#fb9259>Lichen:</color> She has worn a mask since the moment we met, has she not?

steps.content: No... it must have been even earlier than that... From the very moment you chose to enter the Void of Yin in her stead, she had already seen through your disguise.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: You are the remarkable one, young friend. Such power, such wit and nerve, such insight and magnanimity...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Since when did our guide grow into someone I barely recognize? You no longer resemble that "child" at all.
Your thoughts spiral deeper into chaos as an invisible grip tightens around your throat, choking away every last whisper of sound.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: What is the matter? Did you really knock your head hard enough to forget what just happened? Do you not even recognize me?
Can you no longer recognize her? Is the one in front of you even the same person you know?
[Quick cut to memory filter + surface world background + Lichen squinting smile portrait + two silhouettes on the side (the devotee portrait from the end of the previous chapter)]
She schemed through every step of the journey, twisting people's deepest desires to her advantage.
[Quick cut to memory filter + corpse hair-brushing CG]
She made you think the expedition had corrupted her, only to exploit you.
[Quick cut back to present, show Lichen corrupted no-mask portrait]
Now that she has finally reached the <color=#fb9259>Void of Yin</color>, what more does she want from you?
The corner of Lichen's mouth tugs upward. Is that meant to be a smile? Yet that face, no matter how you study it, bears no resemblance to anything still alive.
You wrench your arm upward, twisting free of her wrist. Your heel digs deep into the mud as you kick yourself backward.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You went through all this trouble to lure me down here, just to enter the Void of Yin...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I have no power, and I'm definitely not your "auspicious star." There is nothing I can do for you.
Behind her, specks of pale blue luminescence surface from the darkness, bobbing and sinking like fish swimming through unseen depths.
[Flashback to soul-guiding CG]
It is them. These are the very fish that once guided you safely out of the Void of Yin.
Could you rely on them to escape again? Though you have no idea how to communicate with them...

steps.speaker: Fish
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>...Please...</color><i>

steps.speaker: Fish
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>...our... wish...</color><i>
<color=#fb9259>And yet, every word they speak rings clear in your mind.</color>

steps.speaker: Fish
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>...Please, gods...</color><i>

steps.speaker: Fish
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>...grant... our wishes...</color><i>
As each word sharpens into clarity, the flecks of light begin to shift, slowly drawing out human silhouettes. They flicker and sway, indistinct as reflections upon a river's surface.
In the next breath, the phantoms rush toward you.
